high_level_description: The image is a split-screen featuring two prominent political figures from India. On the left side of the image: The person is wearing a colorful turban with a mix of yellow, green, and red patterns. They have a white beard and are dressed in formal attire, including a white shirt. The individual appears to be speaking into a microphone, suggesting they are giving a speech or addressing an audience. A large lotus flower emblem is prominently displayed in the foreground, which is often associated with the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), the ruling party in India.
